採用・広告の製品.quote: With improved AI-powered segmentation, advanced measurement capabilities, and integrated reporting, discover the next generation of our flagship software.

Dragonfly is a powerful, AI-driven image processing software platform used for scientific visualization, segmentation, measurement, and reporting. Built for simplicity and scalability, Dragonfly's products are trusted across academia and industry for 2D, 3D, and 4D data analysis.
is an advanced software platform designed for visualizing, analyzing, and interpreting multi-dimensional imaging data - from micro-CT to electron microscopy and more.
It seamlessly integrates a powerful suite of tools for image processing, segmentation, quantification, machine learning, 3D modeling, and reporting—all in a single, flexible environment.
"This breakthrough software provides a previously unattainable level of precision and accuracy in the characterization and visualization of intricate structures, setting new standards"

Dragonfly Social is more than a support hub – it’s a growing global community of scientists, engineers, and students sharing insights, tutorials, datasets, and innovations. Sign up to access exclusive how-to videos, developer tips, and community-driven problem solving.
